title: Research question selection phase result (paper team, research-questions.md)
description: Validates the structured result object the idea-selection phase returns alongside its research-questions.md artifact. artifactPath must equal the artifact name the phase declares in team.yml (the core's runtime enforces the same exact match); openQuestions are required because the human review gate needs the unresolved risks before selecting one candidate.

artifactPath.description: Exactly the artifact name the phase declares in team.yml; the runtime writes the reply body there and rejects any other value.

summary.description: Structured Chinese summary that names each candidate research question (two to three) with its novelty argument against the surveyed work and its main risks across data availability, evaluation, baselines, time and compute, and scientific significance.

citations.description: Optional: survey citation keys reused to ground the novelty arguments; refs must match the keys used in survey.md.

openQuestions.description: Unresolved decisions and risks the human gate must weigh before selecting one question; every candidate's risks appear here and no upstream open question is silently dropped.

ref.description: Citation key exactly as it appears in survey.md, e.g. "[1]" or "[Vaswani2017]".

claim.description: The specific novelty argument or risk statement this source supports.

source.description: Identifying string of the cited work as available from the reviewed materials: title, authors, year, venue or URL.

retractionChecked.description: True only when the reviewer actually verified this work's retraction status; unverifiable status stays false.
